description: Is a creative WEARING OUT? TikTok’s own creative-fatigue verdict per creative per day over the last 14 days, with spend and cost per conversion — the signal to make a fresh variation and swap it in. TikTok computes it for Upgraded Smart+ ad groups: pass the adgroupId and Hermoso reads every creative (ad material) in it, or name adMaterialIds. Read-only, free.

adMaterialIds.description: optional; default every creative in the ad group

advertiserId.description: TikTok ad account id from list_tiktok_ads_accounts; omit when only one account is shared with this profile

startDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD, within the last 14 days (default 7 days ago)

name: tiktok_ads_creative_fatigue
title: TikTok creative fatigue
